about_the_game:
Heart Idler is a clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate collection of hearts?

  • Click to Generate Hearts: Start with zero hearts and click hearts that fly out to get more hearts.

  • Upgrade Your Abilities: Spend your hearts on a variety of upgrades to increase your heart production.

  • Idle Progression: Earn hearts even when you're not actively playing. Come back to a wealth of hearts and new opportunities.

  • Unlock New Skins and Cosmetics: Customize your game by unlocking new heart skins and backgrounds.

  • Charming Graphics: Enjoy cute and colorful visuals as you grow your heart collection.

  • Endless Fun: See how many hearts you can collect

  • Join the heart-collecting frenzy and see how far you can go in Heart Idler!
